'''Kanna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] she was stationed at the [[Prison Administration Center]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]].<ref name="The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
